page.heading: About Vernal Medicare
page.description: I'm Rocco DeLuca, a local, licensed agent in Vernal, Utah. Simple help with Medicare, under-65 coverage, copay coverage, and life insurance—no pressure.
page.summary: I'm Rocco DeLuca, a local, licensed insurance agent based in Vernal. I help Uintah Basin residents choose Medicare Advantage, Medigap, Part D, under-65 Marketplace coverage, copay (fixed indemnity) plans, and life insurance — in plain English, at no extra cost, with year-round support.

meta.ogDescription: Local, face-to-face help choosing Medicare and health coverage that fits your needs and budget.

services.intro: Pick a topic to see how it works and what's available in the Uintah Basin.

items.title: Medicare Advantage
items.text: All-in-one plans that combine hospital, medical, and often drug coverage.

items.title: Medicare Supplement (Medigap)
items.text: Helps pay the costs Original Medicare leaves behind.

items.title: Prescription Drug Plans (Part D)
items.text: Compare drug plans for the medications you actually take.

items.title: Under-65 Marketplace Health Insurance
items.text: Marketplace plans for individuals and families under 65.

items.title: Life Insurance
items.text: Term and final-expense coverage for your family's future.

services.noteHtml: I also help with copay coverage (fixed indemnity). There's no extra cost to you — agents are typically paid by the plan or carrier if you enroll.

together.intro: A simple, no-pressure process. Open any step to see what it involves.

steps.title: Listen
steps.short: Your needs and budget come first.
steps.detailHtml: We start with what matters to you: your doctors, your prescriptions, and what you can comfortably spend each month. If you have them handy, bring your Medicare card and a list of your medications.

steps.title: Compare
steps.short: Simple, side-by-side options in plain English.
steps.detailHtml: I lay out the plans I offer in your county side by side — premiums, copays, drug costs, and whether your doctors and pharmacy are in network. You decide, with no pressure.

steps.title: Enroll & Support
steps.short: We get it done right — and I'm here year-round.
steps.detailHtml: When you're ready, I help with the enrollment steps that apply to your situation and timing. After that, I'm here year-round for questions about a bill, a claim, or whether your plan still fits when enrollment season comes around.

local.html: Plans, costs, and provider networks can vary by county, and not every plan is offered everywhere. Because I live and work here, I know the local hospitals and pharmacies people in the Basin use, and I can help you check whether yours are in a plan's network.
local.moreHtml: Or read more about working with a local agent.
local.imageAlt: Main Street in Vernal, Utah, with the mountains behind

carriers.html: I work with multiple carriers (availability varies by county). We do not offer every plan available in your area. Any information I provide is limited to the plans I do offer. For info on all your options, visit Medicare.gov or call 1-800-MEDICARE (TTY: 711).

credentials.html: I’m a licensed Medicare insurance agent, and — like every agent who can offer Medicare Advantage and Part D — I complete the AHIP certification and each carrier’s training every year before I can talk plans with you. Here’s what stands behind the advice on this site:
itemsHtml: My credentials & certifications — licensing, annual training, and compliance.
How we keep this site accurate — official sources, single-source annual figures, and review.
What clients say — reviews from local Medicare beneficiaries and their families.

contact.h2: Talk to a Local, Licensed Agent
contact.text: Call or email for a friendly, no-pressure chat. I can walk you through your options in person, by phone, or by video.
contact.quoteText: "Coverage should be simple, local, and matched to you."
